hypotheses.claim: The 100,000-tick Q32.32 fixed-point simulation Form (arena16_q32_32_v1, [-64, +64] arena, 16 bodies + 4 pickups, 732-byte little-endian canonical state) produces 0 SHA-256 checkpoint mismatches across all 1,000 checkpoints (ticks 100..100,000, stride 100) and all 100 stride-1000 checkpoints across arm64 macOS, aarch64 Linux, AMD Zen 5 x86_64 Linux, and Intel Raptor Lake x86_64 Linux across Rust native, Rust Wasm32, C++20 (Clang and GCC), Node.js BigInt, and Python 3 (20+ target x host cells, 20,000+ verified checkpoints).
hypotheses.kill_criterion: Any SHA-256 digest mismatch (> 0) at any checkpoint tick on any (host, ISA, OS, runtime) cell.

hypotheses.claim: Over 25,000 ticks of the identical chaotic arena in IEEE-754 binary64 (f64): (a) pure IEEE-754 algebraic + sqrt arithmetic with FMA contraction disabled (-O3 -ffp-contract=off -fno-fast-math) stays bitwise identical across x86_64 and arm64/aarch64; (b) enabling hardware FMA (-mavx2 -mfma -ffp-contract=fast on x86_64 or fmadd on arm64/aarch64) or calling standard library transcendentals (std::sin/std::cos across Apple libSystem libm vs GNU glibc 2.43 x86_64 vs GNU glibc 2.39 aarch64, even without -ffast-math) diverges at an exact measurable tick t_div and cascades into macroscopic gameplay desynchronization.
hypotheses.kill_criterion: Unexplained divergence under pinned IEEE-754 algebraic arithmetic without FMA/transcendentals, or failure to record exact t_div across cross-ISA / cross-libm pairs.

hypotheses.claim: Projecting 4 canonical Q32.32 simulation snapshots (ticks 0, 250, 1000, 10000) into a 512x512 RGBA8Unorm framebuffer via an identical WGSL vertex+fragment pipeline (trigonometric procedural arena rings, SDF + Blinn-Phong 3D sphere lighting, and SrcAlpha/OneMinusSrcAlpha alpha blending) across 4 physical GPUs spanning 4 GPU architectures and 2 graphics APIs (Apple Metal on M3 Ultra, AMD RADV Vulkan on Radeon 8060S, NVIDIA Vulkan on GeForce RTX 4050, and Intel ANV Vulkan on Iris Xe) produces non-identical raw framebuffer SHA-256 hashes (confirming WGSL floating-point and SFU non-bit-exactness) while remaining strictly inside a perceptual/pixel tolerance gate without any GPU state flowing back into S.
hypotheses.kill_criterion: Any physical GPU pair failing PSNR > 40.0 dB, SSIM > 0.999, or pixel fraction with per-channel |Delta| > 8 exceeding p_max = 0.001, or any upstream Q32.32 state hash mismatch.
